vsm1.8:3.3: 2. “The word ‘etc.’ includes Nanda-yakkha, Nanda-māṇava, and others” (Vism-mhṭ 236). See A-a II 104, and M-a IV 8.
vsm1.8:6.4: 3. For the expression upāya-manasikāra—“attention as a right means” see M-a I 64.

vsm1.8:14.5: 5. The Emperor Asoka is referred to. His name Asoka means “Sorrowless.” This story is in the Asokāvadāna and Divyāvadāna, pp. 429–434.
